devon (SRE): Midshift async check-in — quick notes. What I did: rolled back the kv-evict canary, adjusted eviction policy to max-age=12h, patched the eviction alert threshold to reduce noise. Blockers: intermittent 503s from model-router under burst (seen ~2x in last hour). Suspect cold-starts on dedicated nodes + a routing retry pattern. Today: iterate pre-warm script and run a 30m load test at 10:30am PT against dedicated-pool-a. If it spikes I'll trigger fallback routing. pinging @chris @jen for oncall/infra backup. Details/commands: ```bash
# local prewarm test
python infra/prewarm.py --nodes dedicated-pool-a --concurrency 8 --duration 1800
# fallback toggle
redwood route update model-router --fallback-variant small --duration 300
``` Dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/kv-evict  |  https://redwood.internal/dashboards/model-router :eyes:

chris (oncall): Acknowledged — I'll be on standby for the 10:30 test. If router 503s spike I'll flip fallback for 5m and observe. Also bumped router request timeout to 6s earlier to reduce client timeouts. :thumbsup:

jen (infra): Can you save a few of the 503 error payloads and paste them here when you see them? I added a temporary metric to capture cold-start pct over 5m windows. Heads up: kernel upgrades on dedicated-pool-b tonight at 02:00 PT — shouldn't affect pool-a but worth noting.

liam (manager): Thanks — if capacity looks constrained we can request a short burst-reserve. Please capture a trace/span recording during the test so we can correlate with kv cache evictions. Also update the runbook if we change alert thresholds.

sre-bot: Incident watch: rule 'model-router-503' triggered 1 time(s) in the last 24h. Current SLO: availability 99.5% (7d rolling).

devon (SRE): Will upload logs and runbook diff after the test. If prewarm works I'll plan to revert max-age back to 48h tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone — I'll post quick results after the 10:30 run. :white_check_mark:
